issues: The six cells were generic dashboard cards full of 12–16px text, so lighting one up didn't say what had lit up; dark and lit states differed only in overall opacity
The title was 56px and the hero numbers in the cells were under 30px, so not one piece of text meant to be read was legible at 1080p
The amber comet was just a thin stroke segment with no bright head or bloom, so it read as a border colour change, not as powering on
The lighting order restarted on every row so the light jumped around the wall, and the background stayed equally dark throughout: no energy change once all six were lit
changes: Aurora look (violet-black, lavender, rose accent) for a fictional platform "Basalt", with a 100px headline rising word by word

Each cell tells one thing with one big hero: 38s / 212 / 99.99% / branch URL / SOC 2 / 84ms (112–140px white-to-lavender gradient type), supporting text ≥32px, plus a small graphic (build-time bars, wireframe globe, status strip, shield check, latency curve)

Rebuilt comet: white-to-rose core, three tapering tail layers, Gaussian glow and a bloom dot at the head positioned along the rounded perimeter; after one lap the tail catches the head and dissolves, leaving a thin border that anneals to a steady glow

Snake lighting order (top row left to right, bottom row right to left), with the bottom-row comets starting from the top-right corner to pick up from the previous cell; content brightens and rises 6f later with one overshoot, heroes 3f after that

The room brightens as power comes on: stage key light and dust climb continuously with the number of lit cells; once all are lit, a 30f push from 0.972 to 1 lands exactly on the designed layout, then 22f of stillness
